reference_class_C: Independent binary swaps of pairs of differently labeled, disjoint sites within one natural-class group; all other cells fixed. 2^K elements.
reference_class_N: Within each frame, all permutations of observed center labels at radius-two-collar-matched sites in the same 64-row band. Eligible interior sites satisfy (y+2x)%5=0. Only groups with >=2 observed labels, each with exactly one surrounding 4-connected component touching cardinal neighbors, are variable. All other cells fixed.
invariants: Per-frame areas, boundary-cell union counts, undirected class-pair edge counts and per-class 4-connected-component counts remain exact. Component size distributions and temporal statistics are measured on originals but not claimed invariant.
meaning: Conditional worst-case fixed-length population converse. Uniform-population expected prefix length also obeys it under hard per-object distortion. Not an individual-video minimum, not a measured source distribution, not a realizability certificate.
claim_scope: FORMULATION: explicit local exchange/permutation reference classes
payload_retention: all alternative partition arrays, copied source arrays, exact integer count data, frame checkpoints retained

review_passes.findings_fixed: Outward decimal intervals and retained-input identity on resume.

review_passes.verdict: CLEAN after fixes; checked injectivity, radius-two isolation, topology invariance, arbitrary reproduction centers, lower/upper directions, source provenance and atomic retention.
review_passes.assumption_challenge: Population distinguishability does not imply any fixed incumbent length. Matching observed geometry is not a proof of physical-video reachability or a source probability law.
